contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradictions: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the finding does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001-THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is complementary to corroborated FND-0092 (standard filling system represents zero in St, Broaddus cyclic generator phi0 is different). FND-0102 extends the structural analysis: even knowing that a hyperelliptic involution acts as +id on a symmetric subspace, one still needs the Mod-orbit of im(b: St(Sigma_{0,2g+2}) -> St_g) to generate St_g (or contain a Broaddus cyclic generator up to units) for (St tensor V)_Mod = 0 to follow. Independent verification: (1) Bieri-Eckmann duality for groups of finite vcd gives H^{vcd}(G; V) = (St_G tensor V)_G for the Steinberg/dualizing module St_G, so H^{4g-5}(Mod_g; V) = (St_g tensor V)_{Mod_g} for n=0 is standard. (2) Broaddus (arXiv:1201.3366) proved St_g is a cyclic Z[Mod_g]-module with an explicit generator phi_0 constructed from a nonstandard arc system; the standard 4g-gon filling system represents the zero class (FND-0092). (3) The Birman-Hilden theorem identifies the hyperelliptic mapping class group SMod_g with Mod_{0,2g+2} (up to central extension), giving a natural boundary map b: St(Sigma_{0,2g+2}) -> St_g. For the coinvariant argument to kill (St tensor V)_{Mod} for odd Sp-inflated V, one needs S^- = 0 on S = (St)_I where I is the relevant subgroup. A single hyperelliptic involution acting as +id on C^{sym} only shows that specific involution preserves the symmetric part; it does not force the anti-invariant part of the full coinvariant module to vanish unless the Mod-orbit of im(b) generates St_g. (4) Maximal simplices in the curve complex (systems of 3g-3 disjoint curves) give classes in the Steinberg module but are not themselves generators — the Steinberg module is generated by maximal-rank arc systems, and confusing maximal curve simplices with Steinberg generators is a category error. (5) Humphries generators (a finite generating set for Mod_g of 2g+1 Dehn twists) do not individually or as intersecting chains represent Steinberg module generators. (6) Mod-transitivity on chains of curves does not move arbitrary filling carriers into symmetric position because the Steinberg module generators require specific arc configurations (Broaddus phi_0) that are not Mod-equivalent to the standard filling. Distinct from FND-0092 (specific zero-class error) and from FND-0093 (five-stage forgetful Leray reduction): do not merge. Merge target: none. Promote from candidate to corroborated on independent verification of the Bieri-Eckmann duality framework, Broaddus cyclicity structure, and the orbit-generation requirement for coinvariant vanishing.

scope.generality: all g >= 2 for Steinberg-module structure; Mod_g vcd = 4g-5 for n=0
